ValidationRule.description: Validate Account State Tax Number format
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), ISPICKVAL( BillingCountryCode , "BR"), !REGEX( PMC_SS_StateTaxNumber__c ,"^(\\w{1,20})?$") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: State Tax Number should not exceed 20 characteres and cannot contain special carachters (no dot, no comma, no hifen).
